## Look

kind: commands. Run `tree dashboard/backend` and see store.py, records.py, task.py, phase.py, snapshot.py, journal.py, and server/schemas.py; model.py is gone. Run `uv run python scripts/api_schema.py --check` and `cd dashboard/web/ui && npm run check`. Run `dashboard/bin/web` against a store. All checks pass at 7ff92d3a8eba23bf54cb40485ec3be1c37c5cedd.

## Machine

- Acceptances: every active data-layer acceptance passes at 7ff92d3a8eba23bf54cb40485ec3be1c37c5cedd (orchestra check).
- Review: PASS at 7ff92d3a8eba23bf54cb40485ec3be1c37c5cedd (subject data-layer-review). Integration-report: pass.
- Suite: 268 + 134 + 1232 tests pass at 7ff92d3a8eba23bf54cb40485ec3be1c37c5cedd. The last leg (pytest -m tmux) exits 5; advisory finding suite-advisory-data-layer.
- Spec requirements R1 to R12: verified (assessments data-layer-R1 to data-layer-R12).
- 37 endpoint fixtures unchanged since the characterization commit.

## Attention

- The shared-helpers phase edits the same backend files on unmerged branches; model.py no longer exists, so its merge needs hand resolution.
- A human must drop the tmux pass from the suite command in .canon/config.json (finding suite-command-tmux-pass).
- api-types:check leaves one temp file per run in the system temp directory.
